## Placeholder — not a finished chapter
Inspected contemporaneous sources now exist. This page still does not write the Creekview narrative (Issue #3). It only points to catalogue records.
:::

## What this chapter is for

Later work can reconstruct what Creekview was, who documented it, and how later writers connect it to ECPM or CSIL. This page does not assert that relationship as fact.

## Evidence status

- **Documented facts (inspected):** [Hansard, 24 February 1984](../sources/1984-hansard-mowat-creekview.qmd) (planned move from Pearson to Creekview Co-op); [Hansard, 10 April 1986](../sources/1986-hansard-nielsen-creekview.qmd) (minister reports six residents in place).
- **Bibliographically confirmed (evaluation copy sought):** a 1987 Creekview evaluation is attested by [Mattinson and Rompf 1987](../sources/1987-mattinson-rompf-creekview.qmd) and [Haw 1989](../sources/1989-haw-special-housing-needs.qmd). The [wanted evaluation record](../sources/wanted-creekview-202-evaluation.qmd) preserves the unconfirmed Ryan / Ryan & Wiggins attribution.
- **Later organizational / journalistic accounts:** [SCI BC history](../sources/sci-bc-history.qmd); [Fayerman 2018](../sources/2018-vancouversun-walt-lawrence.qmd).
- **Open questions:** exact title-page of the evaluation; meaning of “202”; Walt Lawrence’s named role versus the unnamed “six”; any formal link from Creekview to ECPM or CSIL.
